observations.code_quote: Note: Fetched the official OpenAPI v1 spec (124KB, 38 paths). The agent platform (/v1/agents and /v1/agents/runs), per-project usage and per-session logs are now synced. What remains is the functions control plane, session artifacts (downloads, uploads, replays) and the contexts lookup. Every Browserbase endpoint is full refresh: only the agent endpoints accept a time filter, and it filters on creation time while the rows keep changing afterwards.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies remaining gaps and refresh strategy; does not change ingestion behavior.
